title: Compliance Framework Expansion Foundation
goal: Expand compliance packaging beyond SOC 2 into ISO 27001 and PCI DSS while keeping every claim evidence-backed.
scope: Implement the next compliance report-package slice for ISO 27001 and PCI DSS mappings using existing methodology, evidence, finding, and report structures. Do not claim certification, attestation, or full control coverage beyond evidence.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found ISO 27001 and PCI DSS were documented but not queued as explicit packages.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add framework packages only where mappings can be evidence-backed. Do not imply certification, CPA attestation, or full compliance.
notes: Control coverage and residual gaps must stay visible.

success_criteria: ISO 27001 and PCI DSS report-package paths or documented templates exist.
Framework output is grouped by controls or requirements with evidence references.
Unmapped findings and untested controls remain explicit.
Markdown, HTML, and PDF behavior is validated if report variants are implemented.
Generated wording avoids certification or attestation overclaims.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Framework output is evidence-backed and scoped.
Untested and unmapped areas remain explicit.
No certification or attestation claim is generated.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Allowed and forbidden compliance language is reviewed.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with compliance expansion changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the expanded compliance baseline and remaining certification limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
